LanguageData.Rimverse_CmdFoundColonyDesc: Leaves colonists on this body to found a colony that runs on its own and shows in the Colonies tab.
LanguageData.Rimverse_ColonyNeedOrbit: The ship must be stopped in orbit of a body.
LanguageData.Rimverse_ColonyBadBody: A colony cannot be founded on this body.
LanguageData.Rimverse_ColonyAlreadyThere: You already have a colony on this body.
LanguageData.Rimverse_ColonyNeedScan: The body needs an exact scan.
LanguageData.Rimverse_ColonyNeedColonists: Needs at least {0} colonists on the map (one stays).
LanguageData.Rimverse_FoundColonyInfo: Planet hazard: {0}. Cost: {1} steel and {2} meals. Choose at least {3} colonists to stay. The one with the best Social becomes administrator.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterColonyFounded: {1} colonists stayed on {0} to found a colony. It grows, produces and pays income on its own. See everything in the Colonies tab.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterColonyWarn: Pirates and rivals are eyeing {0}. If attention reaches 600 it will be attacked. A military base and a good administrator help it hold.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterColonyRaided: {0} was raided. Population fell, the stock was taken and the industry lost was: {1}.
LanguageData.Rimverse_ColoniesNone: You have no colonies yet. Bring colonists into orbit of a scanned body and use Found colony on the bridge.
LanguageData.Rimverse_ColonyLine2: Stability {0} · Last quadrum income {1} · Attention {2} of {3}
LanguageData.Rimverse_ColonyNeedPresence: Bring a ship or colonists to this system to collect stock, deposit or withdraw money.
LanguageData.Rimverse_ColonyDeposit: Deposit all money on the map ({0})
LanguageData.Rimverse_ColonyRecallConfirm: Abandon {0}? The settlers and the stock come here, and the industries are lost.
LanguageData.Rimverse_IndustryDesc_Agriculture: Food for 20 population. Without food the colony shrinks.
LanguageData.Rimverse_IndustryDesc_GasHarvest: 60 chemfuel per quadrum. Needs a gas giant in the system.
LanguageData.Rimverse_IndustryDesc_Refinery: 40 chemfuel and 10 warp matter per quadrum.
LanguageData.Rimverse_IndustryDesc_Factory: 10 components and 2 advanced components per quadrum.
LanguageData.Rimverse_IndustryDesc_MilitaryBase: Defense against attacks on the colony.
LanguageData.Rimverse_IndustryDesc_Shipyard: A base for building and repairing ships (shipyard functions arrive in a later phase).
